visual_goal: Show that the agent never holds the pen: it reads through a policy-checked tool gateway, writes only proposals, every disposition happens in the system of record's own human approval, and an evidence log captures each step.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left a small box with a bell icon labeled 'Trigger', one arrow into a friendly unbranded robot at a desk holding a magnifying glass, labeled 'Agent'. One arrow from the robot into a turnstile gate with a shield icon labeled 'Tool gateway'. From the gateway two arrows: one dashed arrow up-right to a row of three plain server boxes with an eye icon, labeled 'read only'; and one solid arrow right into an inbox tray of draft documents labeled 'Proposals'. One arrow from 'Proposals' into a clipboard with checkmarks labeled 'Validation'. One arrow into a desk where a generic person holds a large pen and signs a page, labeled 'Human approval'. From 'Human approval' two arrows: one right into an open ledger book with a round green checkmark seal on its page, labeled 'Posted', and one down into a small folder labeled 'Feedback'. Along the bottom of the whole picture runs a long roll of paper tape labeled 'Evidence log', with one thin dotted line down into it from each of 'Agent', 'Tool gateway' and 'Human approval'. Exactly nine arrows and three dotted lines.
alt: A trigger starts the agent, which goes through a tool gateway that allows read-only access to systems and lets it write only proposals; proposals pass validation and a human approval, which posts to the ledger or returns feedback, while an evidence log records the agent, gateway and approval steps.

visual_goal: Show a proposal's lifecycle: the agent controls only the first state, validation and reviewers decide the rest, and amended and rejected proposals are kept because they measure the agent's error rate and form the next evaluation set.
prompt: A state map drawn as rounded stepping stones. At the far left a stone 'Proposed' inside a small softly highlighted zone with a tiny unbranded robot standing on it. From 'Proposed' one short arrow down to a grey stone 'Rejected by rule', and one arrow right into a stone 'Awaiting review' with a small generic reviewer figure. From 'Awaiting review' three arrows: one straight right into a green stone 'Approved'; one down-right into an orange stone 'Amended'; one down into a red stone 'Rejected'. One arrow from 'Amended' up into 'Approved'. Then along the top row: one arrow from 'Approved' into a stone 'Posted' with a ledger icon, and one arrow from 'Posted' into a stone 'Reconciled' with two matching checkmarks. Below 'Amended' and 'Rejected' sits a labeled basket 'Evaluation set'; one dotted line runs down into it from 'Amended' and one from 'Rejected'. Exactly eight arrows and two dotted lines.
alt: Stepping stones from Proposed, the only state the agent controls, to Awaiting review, then Approved, Posted and Reconciled; validation failures end Rejected by rule, reviewer changes go through Amended, and amended and rejected proposals drop into an evaluation set.
